WITH rpt_presence AS (
SELECT src.id, src.agent_id, src.agent_name, src.presence_state, src.reason_code, src.source, src.started_at, src.ended_at, src.duration_seconds FROM (
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.organization_id,
  p.agent_id,
  COALESCE(a.display_name, 'Unknown') AS agent_name,
  p.new_state AS presence_state,
  p.reason_code,
  p.source,
  p.started_at,
  COALESCE(
    LEAD(p.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_id, p.organization_id ORDER BY p.started_at),
    NOW()
  ) AS ended_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    COALESCE(
      LEAD(p.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_id, p.organization_id ORDER BY p.started_at),
      NOW()
    ) - p.started_at
  )) AS duration_seconds
FROM ccass.agent_presence_history p
LEFT JOIN ccass.agents a ON a.id = p.agent_id
WHERE p.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT agent_name, MAX(started_at) AS most_recent_activity FROM rpt_presence AS presence GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY most_recent_activity DESC LIMIT 1
